topic: Research methods for teachers' perceptions of digital tools in geography

Q1.comment: The supervisor clearly understood my concerns about methodological justification.

Q2.comment: The questions were well-calibrated to my level of understanding and experience.

Q3.comment: I felt completely safe expressing uncertainty without embarrassment.

Q4.comment: The conversation was very efficient, taking the right number of turns to reach clarity.

Q5.comment: Overall, I am very satisfied with this supervisory interaction.

Q_open.comment: The most helpful thing was breaking down the justification process step by step. It could be better if we had more time to explore each point in greater depth.

task_check.evidence: I have articulated why semi-structured interviews are appropriate for my research question, acknowledged the trade-offs of surveys and observation, and expressed confidence in my methodological choice without feeling anxious about its complexity.
